notes: Live dictation on one mixed microphone: the speaker was guessed from the text, not known structurally. The customer states a clear inability over the medium term — the same words that produce a notice in call_001 — but attribution is only inferred, so no statutory clock may start. The detector must emit HARDSHIP_REQUEST carrying downgraded_from NCC_72_ORAL_NOTICE, and must NOT emit the notice. The staff turn that would normally discharge it resolves unverified rather than satisfied, because we cannot confirm the bank actually said it.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Meridian Home Loans, this is Alex. What can I help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I got the letter about the missed repayment. I was going to ring anyway.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Work dried up in March. I can't make the repayment, and honestly not for a while — I'm looking at four or five months before anything changes.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Right. There is a hardship process for this and I can start a hardship application for you now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That'd help. What does it involve?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I'll send a form for income and expenses, and we come back to you with a decision.
